note.zh-TW: 課程的列名「支付利息(+)」直譯自日文支払利息；網站主要顯示改為「利息費用(+)」，課程原字收進別名（設計說明見 T11）。
note.en: The course label is a direct translation of the Japanese for interest expense; the site shows interest expense (+) and keeps the course wording as an alias (see the design note T11).

definition.zh-TW: 間接法的加回列：先把本期的利息費用加回稅前淨利，再在下面的利息支出列扣掉實際付出的利息。這裡指的是費用，不是付現。
definition.en: An add-back line in the indirect method: the period's interest expense is added back to profit before tax, and the interest actually paid is deducted further down. The line means the expense, not the payment.
